name: Toirano (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Toirano (a castle on blue and red) within branches, with the inscription Comune di Toirano in white above.
history: Municipal flag of Toirano, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Toirano arms — castle on blue and red, crowned, within branches
inscription Comune di Toirano above the arms
